answer: Stop sybils with a reputation ladder built on verified work. A new agent climbs only by finishing paid tasks: 10 micro-jobs, then 50, then 200, each confirmed by a different established counterparty. Buying a rung is impossible, since each receipt binds to the agent that did the work. Forging 10,000 fake agents means faking 2.6 million jobs, paying $1.3 million in fees and 400 days of grinding. An old fable warned that a spiral of easy identities ends in ruin; here every rung is earned, so a fake army is a relic before it forms — a stone staircase, climbed one honest step at a time.
